notes: Weekend Mass language reminders for the priest and founder, and an About description for every role in Users Data.
new: The priest and founder get notifications asking for the weekend Mass language: three reminders the day before (8:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 7:00 PM) and two on the day (4:00 AM, 5:00 AM). They stop as soon as the language is set.
A reminder card on Home tells the priest and founder when Saturday or Sunday still has no Mass language, with a button to set it.
Users Data now shows an About section with a role description for every role, including the Oratory Crew and the Chapel Preparation and Cleaning Crew.
changed: Run patch_lang_reminder.sql once in Supabase to turn on the notification reminders (steps are in SETUP.md).
